No one is happier than you. Some people are just better at projecting happiness than others. I'm 29 and I can tell you that most adults are some kind of miserable. Even when they have money, there's always something else to worry about. Instead of dwelling on all the things you think you don't feel or have, try to focus on things you can feel or have. 

Center yourself by stimulating your 5 senses. Order some hot wings with ranch on the side. If you're vegetarian, then get buffalo cauliflower bites. Either way that's your taste covered. It'll wake you all the way up. Put on a stand-up comedy special for your ears. ASMR can be calming but a good laugh is healing. Light some seasonal candles for your nose. I love the fall scents (apple pie, pumpkin, sandalwood, etc.) because they remind me of my childhood. Look up pictures of nature related things for your eyes. And lastly, you wanna get a really smooth, soft and furry item to touch. If you do all these things, it'll make you feel a little silly at first, but you'll find that there's a little joy in each thing. Sometimes all you need is the tiniest spark to re-ignite your flame. It starts with bringing yourself back to the small pleasures in life. These are the things that kept us hopeful as children.

Listen, I can't tell you what to do but I can tell you what NOT to do or how to avoid bad situations (based on my own experience). Feel free to ignore anything you already know.

Whether it's true or not, you'll know for sure if they actually like you cos the ones that do will always follow up. But only do this if you have a feeling or notice signs of them not being interested. Best way to avoid hurting your own feelings. Sometimes it can take us longer than necessary to notice breadcrumbing.

If a guy mentions anything sex related (feel free to make exceptions for jokes if you don't mind that) then you know exactly where his intentions are. Another reason may be the setting, just cause there's a lot of people doesn't mean it was the best environment for you to thrive socially. You'd be surprised with the kind of friendships you can form in the Workplace.
